svg.title: Paper Abby 21. The hedge

g.text: Two sticks on each road. The long road's ball does not pay.
Ink three dashed circles per treat.
Paw is Abby. Flag is the last dot. Trees have no dot. A heavy edge is a cliff: go around.
Waves need the vest. An arch needs the lamp. Pick it up, then step in.
One circle each new dot. A treat inks three more. None left: erase and redraw.
The flag may take the last circle. Score is sticks + balls + treats − steps. Higher is better.

svg.text: Erase is free. Higher is better.
